final:
The three models now download about 1.17 MB in total, down from 19.8 MB. I haven't loaded the page in a browser, so the viewer change is untested.

Each model was compressed with the recipe `node-assets tune --for size` found for it. All three keep the tool's worst-region SSIM at or above the 0.9 limit.

| Model | Before | After | Textures | Fidelity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `boombox.glb` | 10.61 MB | 331 KB | AVIF, 2048px, q50 color / q90 data maps | 0.901 |
| `helmet.glb` | 3.77 MB | 546 KB | AVIF, 2048px, q60 | 0.901 |
| `toycar.glb` | 5.42 MB | 291 KB | WebP, 256px, q50 | 0.901 |

All three use Draco geometry.

The Draco decoder is a one-time download of about 75 KB gzipped, shared by all three models. I copied `draco_wasm_wrapper.js` and `draco_decoder.wasm` from three 0.170 into `public/draco/`. In `src/viewer.js` I added a `DRACOLoader` that points at `/draco/` and is set to use only the wasm decoder, so the larger JS fallback isn't fetched. `public/models/` now holds the compressed files; `assets/` is untouched.

- **Fidelity is at the limit:** 0.901 is right at the 0.9 threshold. Each recipe was tuned to the smallest size that still passes, so there's no margin.
- **Toycar textures:** the toycar textures are shrunk to 256px, and the tool rates that as fine at 1024px view size. Look at it on screen before shipping, because a larger texture is the safer choice if it looks soft. The 1024px AVIF version was 551 KB.
- **Recipes:** they're in `recipes/` if you want to re-run them.
- **Dependencies:** the project has no `node_modules`, so I didn't run `vite build`.
bash_cmds: ls -la . assets public public/models src; node-assets --help; cat src/viewer.js
cat package.json; node-assets tune --help; node-assets tune assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb --for size --network 4g -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -60
node-assets tune assets/boombox.glb assets/helmet.glb assets/toycar.glb --for size --amortize 3 --time-limit 9m -o recipes/ 2>&1 | tail -25

cp recipes_h/helmet.size.recipe.toon recipes/; for m in boombox helmet toycar; do node-assets run recipes/$m.size.recipe.toon assets/$m.glb -o public/models/$m.glb --force 2>&1 | tail -3; done; ls -l public/models; find / -name "draco_decoder*" -path "*three*" 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules 2>&1 | head -3

D=/tmp/scratch_tools/deps/node_modules/three/examples/jsm/libs/draco/gltf; ls -l $D; grep '"version"' /tmp/scratch_tools/deps/node_modules/three/package.json
mkdir -p public/draco && cp $D/draco_wasm_wrapper.js $D/draco_decoder.wasm public/draco/
python3 - <<'E'
p='src/viewer.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { OrbitControls","import { DRACOLoader } from 'three/addons/loaders/DRACOLoader.js';\nimport { OrbitControls",1)
s=s.replace("const loader = new GLTFLoader();","// Models use Draco geometry; only the wasm decoder is fetched (served from public/draco/).\nconst draco = new DRACOLoader().setDecoderPath('/draco/');\ndraco.setDecoderConfig({ type: 'wasm' });\nconst loader = new GLTFLoader().setDRACOLoader(draco);",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
ls -l public/draco; gzip -c public/draco/draco_wasm_wrapper.js|wc -c; gzip -c public/draco/draco_decoder.wasm|wc -c
